content.comment_body: I am using [product_name] [version_no] software with device [article_no]. Upload and download actions are possible. The process works fine on the computer, but on the device, [article_no], programming via the display does not work as expected—the screen appears without the program.
The description of your issue is a bit unclear. If possible, please attach photos to show the specific problem you are encountering. That way, someone may be able to assist you.

[@user_name] Are you using the demo (free) version of the software or the paid version? Also, are you using the required USB cable, have you installed the necessary driver, and have you selected the USB cable within the software settings? Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulty programming [product_name] hardware with [product_name] software. While communication and file transfer between the software and the hardware seem to work, the programming does not execute correctly on the device. The underlying cause is unclear, and users express confusion about the status or error indications received from the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that after transferring the program between the software and the [product_name] device, the hardware should function and operate in accordance with the configuration made in the software.
